entities.title: Bubble
entities.summary: The ordered list of at most 13 objects near the player: the planet in slot 0, the sun or station in slot 1, ships after.

entities.title: Slot
entities.summary: An object's place in the bubble; removing an object shifts the later ones down one slot.

entities.title: Tick
entities.summary: One step of the sim's logic, 12 a second, made of two substeps.
notToBeConfusedWith: A frame: the picture draws at display rate, interpolating between ticks.

entities.title: Substep
entities.summary: Half a tick: every object moves by half a step; the even substep runs the tick logic.

entities.title: Main counter (C)
entities.summary: The cockpit's counter that every flight tick counts down; its phases time the planet and sun checks, recharge and tidying, and its reaching 0 the periodic spawn.

entities.title: Market byte
entities.summary: The per-visit number drawn on arrival that shifts every price and availability until the next jump.

entities.title: Safe zone
entities.summary: Where the station is present: pirates calm down, rocks stop coming and the hop is refused.

entities.title: The Deep
entities.summary: Mis-jump space, where a mis-jump (3 in 256) drops the pilot among the Hush with no planet or station.

entities.title: Reach
entities.summary: A galaxy of 256 systems; there are eight, numbered 1–8.

entities.title: Spindle
entities.summary: The station in every system.

entities.title: Dart
entities.summary: The missile.

entities.title: Hush
entities.summary: The alien faction: the Hush carrier (mothership) and its motes (drones).

entities.title: Scrambler
entities.summary: The E.C.M. unit: its 32-tick pulse destroys every guided missile in flight.
notToBeConfusedWith: Jammer kits, a mildly illegal goods item.

entities.title: Nova charge
entities.summary: The area blast: while it is active, every ship in the bubble but the station is killed.

entities.title: Lifeboat
entities.summary: The escape pod, and an escape pod another ship launches.

entities.title: Auto-berth
entities.summary: The docking computer: docks at once from anywhere in the safe zone.

entities.title: Reach drive
entities.summary: The galaxy drive: used up by one jump to the next Reach.

entities.title: Hop
entities.summary: The in-system jump of one far unit towards the planet.

entities.title: Scrip (SC)
entities.summary: The currency, shown with one decimal; the sim counts it in tenths.

entities.title: Mount
entities.summary: One of four laser positions: fore, aft, port, starboard; the active mount is the one that fires.

entities.title: Cockpit
entities.summary: The player's in-flight state that is not saved; a flight-state reset sets it again.

entities.title: Pilot
entities.summary: Both the person playing (Actors/pilot.md) and the saved record of their ship, cash, cargo and record (Pilot).

entities.title: Main generator
entities.summary: The one random generator whose draws, and their order, are part of the rules.
notToBeConfusedWith: The cosmetic generator, which only the picture uses.

entities.title: Baseline
entities.summary: The private faithful recreation RULES was written from; only the spec-and-verify role reads it.

sources.symbol: Starting point: a clean room from the private recreation

entities.title: Deliberate difference
entities.summary: A numbered place where LodeStar knowingly differs from the baseline, listed in RULES.

entities.title: Status marks
entities.summary: Knowledge-driven development's marks in the documents beside the code: ✅ built and tested, ⚠️ promised but not yet true, ❌ a known defect.
